name: five_lockstep
description: Five VMs snapped and rolled back as one group: two 86Box DOS nodes the GUI launches itself (ms4144_486, MEMLOOP) and three QEMU guests it attaches to by QMP port (Win 3.1 / i386, Solaris 9 / SPARC SS-5, Mac Q800 / m68k). The QEMUs are started by the testlist (rmm-demo-lockstep5) with monitor ports 55611-55613, so QMP is on 56611-56613. Group snap / restore use savevm / loadvm on the QEMU nodes, so each guest's writable disks must be qcow2.
